5187.title: [release/4.153.x] Disable RAW and DNG image decoding
5187.body:
[release/4.153.x] Disable RAW and DNG image decoding (#5187)

Context: https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5162
Requires: https://github.com/mono/skia/pull/379
Changes: https://github.com/mono/skia/compare/d457ae4d1c82de55c9a84c8957869c8617be3939...45afab4f1f0921f3feb97f58cf89b136fffa85e6

Backport the RAW/DNG removal to release/4.153.x so SkiaSharp no longer
advertises or builds the retired decoder. Keep the public Dng enum value
and native ABI unchanged; this changes codec availability, not signatures.

~~ Disable the native RAW codec consistently ~~

Set skia_use_dng_sdk=false and skia_use_piex=false in shared
GenerateGnBuild and remove conflicting platform arguments. WASM already
disabled both features. Drop Alpine's __WORDSIZE compiler define because
its purpose was compiling dng_sdk. Update the Linux manual-build
instructions and bitmap guide to describe the unsupported codec.

~~ Stop acquiring unused native sources ~~

The companion native change comments out dng_sdk and piex in DEPS, so
dependency synchronization no longer fetches them. Remove their Component
Governance registrations and update dependency documentation.

Pin the gitlink and manifest to native release merge
45afab4f1f0921f3feb97f58cf89b136fffa85e6, not the reviewed branch head.
Its tree 90f7524936e1bdfcad6733e654710e5e1f280c43 matches the reviewed
native commit exactly. Preserve M153 versions and unrelated dependency pins.

~~ Remove the unsupported Gallery choice and prove rejection ~~

Remove AdobeDng and the DNG picker entry, shifting WebP/GIF indices to
keep remaining choices aligned. Move the original image byte-for-byte
into test content. DngIsNotDecoded checks null codec results from files
and managed streams with Unimplemented, and null data-codec, bitmap,
and image results. Retain SKEncodedImageFormat.Dng = 10 for compatibility;
no replacement RAW decoder is introduced.

The macOS ARM64 native source and Gallery shared builds passed. Dependency
sync omitted the retired inputs, and the GN/Ninja graph excluded the codec.
The local unfiltered console suite failed solely on the documented
Ganesh GL DiagonalLines golden mismatch. An untouched M151 base reproduced
the same image hashes, but an untouched M153 native baseline was not run.
No visual tests, goldens, tolerances, or skips were changed.

Co-authored-by: Matthew Leibowitz <mattleibow@live.com>
Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

5158.title: [4.153] Backport AcesShared Apple CI and Xcode 26.3
5158.body:
[4.153] Backport AcesShared Apple CI and Xcode 26.3 (#5158)

Context: https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5146

Backport the public Apple CI configuration from main to `release/4.153.x`.
This line has the same hosted `macos-15` defaults and 26.3/16.2
managed/native Xcode split as the source baseline, so retain both decisions
together.

~~ Move release/4.153.x macOS jobs to AcesShared ~~

`buildAgentMac` and `buildAgentMacNative` previously used `Azure Pipelines`
with `vmImage: macos-15`. Route both through `AcesShared` with
`ImageOverride -equals ACES_VM_SharedPool_Sequoia` so managed macOS work and
the native Apple stage share the same pool configuration.

~~ Align the native Xcode selector ~~

The common bootstrapper selects `XCODE_VERSION_NATIVE` for names beginning
with `native_`. The iOS, Mac Catalyst, macOS, and tvOS jobs take that path,
while managed macOS uses `XCODE_VERSION`. Raise the native pin from 16.2 to
26.3 so the release line no longer selects separate Apple compiler baselines.

Co-authored-by: Matthew Leibowitz <mattleibow@live.com>
Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
